in_sanskrit.name: Dolat
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Wealthy, Prosperous
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Dolat एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Dolat is a Sanskrit name derived from the word ‘dola,’ meaning wealth or prosperity. In Hindu mythology, Lord Vishnu is often depicted as holding a pot of gold or wealth, symbolizing the abundance and prosperity he brings. This name is a reminder of the divine blessings of wealth and prosperity.
